entries.title: John 17:1
segments: These things spake Jesus; and lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, Father, the hour is come; glorify thy Son, that the son may glorify thee:

entries.title: John 17:2
segments: even as thou gavest him authority over all flesh, that to all whom thou hast given him, he should give eternal life.

entries.title: John 17:3
segments: And this is life eternal, that they should know thee the only true God, and him whom thou didst send, [even] Jesus Christ.

entries.title: John 17:4
segments: I glorified thee on the earth, having accomplished the work which thou hast given me to do.

entries.title: John 17:5
segments: And now, Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.

entries.title: John 17:6
segments: I manifested thy name unto the men whom thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them to me; and they have kept thy word.

entries.title: John 17:7
segments: Now they know that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are from thee:

entries.title: John 17:8
segments: for the words which thou gavest me I have given unto them; and they received [them], and knew of a truth that I came forth from thee, and they believed that thou didst send me.

entries.title: John 17:9
segments: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for those whom thou hast given me; for they are thine:

entries.title: John 17:10
segments: and all things that are mine are thine, and thine are mine: and I am glorified in them.

entries.title: John 17:11
segments: And I am no more in the world, and these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep them in thy name which thou hast given me, that they may be one, even as we [are].

entries.title: John 17:12
segments: While I was with them, I kept them in thy name which thou hast given me: and I guarded them, and not one of them perished, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.

entries.title: John 17:13
segments: But now I come to thee; and these things I speak in the world, that they may have my joy made full in themselves.

entries.title: John 17:14
segments: I have given them thy word; and the world hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

entries.title: John 17:15
segments: I pray not that thou shouldest take them from the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil [one].

entries.title: John 17:16
segments: They are not of the world even as I am not of the world.

entries.title: John 17:17
segments: Sanctify them in the truth: thy word is truth.

entries.title: John 17:18
segments: As thou didst send me into the world, even so sent I them into the world.

entries.title: John 17:19
segments: And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.

entries.title: John 17:20
segments: Neither for these only do I pray, but for them also that believe on me through their word;

entries.title: John 17:21
segments: that they may all be one; even as thou, Father, [art] in me, and I in thee, that they also may be in us: that the world may believe that thou didst send me.

entries.title: John 17:22
segments: And the glory which thou hast given me I have given unto them; that they may be one, even as we [are] one;

entries.title: John 17:23
segments: I in them, and thou in me, that they may be perfected into one; that the world may know that thou didst send me, and lovedst them, even as thou lovedst me.

entries.title: John 17:24
segments: Father, I desire that they also whom thou hast given me be with me where I am, that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.

entries.title: John 17:25
segments: O righteous Father, the world knew thee not, but I knew thee; and these knew that thou didst send me;

entries.title: John 17:26
segments: and I made known unto them thy name, and will make it known; that the love wherewith thou lovedst me may be in them, and I in them.
